features.name: Kong gateway → ExtremeRouter model enumeration & chat routing fix
features.behavior: Kong proxy (8090) forwards ExtremeRouter's remote API key upstream and serves /v1/models and /v1/chat/completions to agents (Hermes, OpenCode) authenticated via per-consumer key-auth keys.

evidence.command: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/models -H "apikey: $(sops -d layers/00-cyberia/03-treasure/secrets/external_services.yaml | grep '^kong_key_hermes' | awk '{print $2}')" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]))'
evidence.output: 538 — Kong proxy now enumerates 538 ExtremeRouter models over HTTP (was 426 https-only + 401 no-upstream-auth).
